module: Registry of organizations (career mode factions with reputation), loaded from the `gameplay/organizations/*.organizations.json` files and enriched with the career's reputation data. Also provides UI-ready data. Global: freeroam_organizations.
notes: Depends on the career modules (career_modules_reputation, career_career, career_modules_delivery_generator): getOrganizations calls addAdditionalInfoToOrg which uses career_modules_reputation without a nil test, so outside career these globals must exist.
Each organization receives: id (file key), visible, attributeKey (= id .. 'Reputation') and the reputation fields.

getUIDataForOrg: deepcopy then reputation max/min/label, offersDeliveries, hasUnlocks, associatedFacilities, and for each reputation level label and level (= index - 2). It dereferences organization.reputation without a test: an unknown org returns nil (error log in getOrganization).

getOrganization.desc: Returns an organization by id (refreshing its reputation) or nil with an error log.

getUIData.desc: List of the organizations in UI format (getUIDataForOrg), sorted by translated name.

getUIDataForOrg.desc: Enriched copy of an organization for the UI.
